channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Hacker Detained in Jordan Over FBI Data Theft
item.description: A hacker known as ShinyHunters has been detained in Jordan in connection with a data theft involving the FBI. Sources indicate the individual is cooperating with the bureau. The detention occurred in Jordan. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Flydubai Jet Plunged 14,000 Feet in Under a Minute
item.description: A Flydubai passenger jet experienced a rapid descent, falling approximately 14,000 feet in about 30 seconds. The incident resulted in damage to the aircraft, attributed to extreme speeds, angles, and G-force loads. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: GST arrest powers may be removed; data access for agencies to be discussed
item.description: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council is scheduled to discuss the removal of arrest powers under the GST regime on October 7, potentially addressing concerns about overreach by tax authorities. The government may introduce an amendment… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Nida Khan, the main accused in the TCS Nashik case, is facing increased legal difficulties as her husband has filed for divorce. A court has issued a summons in connection with the divorce petition. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: A fire broke out at the Murshidabad home of Trinamool MLA Bayron Biswas, resulting in burn injuries to the legislator. Fire tenders were deployed to control the blaze, and an investigation into the incident is underway. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: News Crew Hit by Vehicle During Live Broadcast in Mexico
item.description: A news crew in Monterrey, Mexico, was struck by a vehicle during a live broadcast. The incident, which involved a Jeep-type vehicle, resulted in injuries to the reporter and cameraperson. One report described the event as 'part of the job'. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Army hands over girl to police after LoC crossing
item.description: The Indian Army has handed over a 17-year-old girl to the police after she crossed the Line of Control (LoC) in Rajouri, Jammu and Kashmir. The incident occurred in the Nowshera sector of Rajouri. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Two people were killed and another injured in a mob lynching incident in West Bengal, reportedly over suspicion of cattle theft. The incident occurred in North Bengal. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Elderly Couple Hit by SUV in Delhi; Driver Arrested
item.description: An elderly couple was struck by an SUV in Kirti Nagar, Delhi. The driver of the SUV has been arrested. CCTV footage reportedly shows the couple being flung into the air after the vehicle collided with them outside a temple. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 3.

item.description: Following the Indore water tragedy, the Congress party has demanded an FIR and the resignation of the mayor. A panel investigating the incident flagged lapses in the pipeline, with Congress also seeking answers regarding missing records… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: Multiple reports detail cyber fraud incidents across India. In one case, a judicial institution employee's account was hacked, leading to a loss of ₹99,000, and police have registered a case. Separately, in Bhind, eight individuals… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: The West Bengal government has announced a fresh probe into the leg and waist injuries sustained by Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee during her 2021 election campaign. The injury occurred in 2021, and one report notes that Suvendu Adhikari… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.description: Internet and phone networks have been disrupted in Ethiopia's war-hit Tigray region following renewed fighting. The civil war in Tigray had previously led to the region being completely cut off from the outside world. Ethiopia's military… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 7 · Right 1.

item.description: A federal judge has temporarily blocked the Trump administration from restarting border wall construction in the Big Bend region of Texas. The order specifically halts work in a national park. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
